commitResults.messageTitle: Add delete command and switch task storage to ArrayList
commitResults.messageBody:
Implements 'delete n' to remove the nth task from the list. Also
replaces the fixed-size Task[100] array (with manual idx tracking)
with an ArrayList<Task> for dynamic sizing and simpler add/remove
logic, removing the now-unnecessary "maximum tasks" check.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Gradle build with shadowJar plugin for fat JAR packaging
commitResults.messageBody:
Adds build.gradle (java + application + com.gradleup.shadow plugins,
Java 25 toolchain, entry point friday.Friday) and settings.gradle, plus
a Gradle wrapper pinned to 9.7.1 (the first Gradle release that runs on
JDK 25) so the fat JAR can be built with `./gradlew shadowJar` without
requiring a separate Gradle install.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-Level-6: ArrayList task storage and delete command
Merge branch-Level-7: file storage, edge-case handling, and Gradle shadowJar build
commitResults.messageBody:
Resolved conflicts in Friday.java by combining both branches: kept
branch-Level-6's ArrayList<Task> storage and delete command as the
base, and layered branch-Level-7's save/load-to-disk, EOF-safe input
handling, and '|' character validation on top. delete now persists to
disk like the other mutating commands. Verified by compiling, running
an add/mark/delete/restart sequence, and building the shadow JAR.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract Storage class for save/load of tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
Friday's main class previously mixed UI, command parsing, and file
I/O together in static methods. This pulls the file I/O slice out
first since it is the most self-contained: saveTasks/loadTasks/
parseTaskFromFile become Storage.save()/load(), with the file path
now bound to a Storage instance (new Storage(SAVE_FILE_PATH)) rather
than passed around implicitly via a static constant.

Behavior is unchanged - verified by scripting a session that adds a
todo/deadline/event, lists, marks/unmarks, deletes, exits, then
restarts and reloads from disk, and confirming a corrupted save-file
line is still skipped with the same warning.

This is the first of several planned extractions (Ui, Parser,
TaskList next) working toward the "extract classes" increment in the
course's iP instructions.

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-8 (minimal): store deadline dates as LocalDate
commitResults.messageBody:
Deadline.by changes from a free-text String to a java.time.LocalDate,
per the Level-8 minimal requirement. User input after '/by' is parsed
with LocalDate.parse (ISO yyyy-MM-dd, e.g. "2019-12-02") and rejected
with a helpful error if it doesn't match; display uses a separate
"MMM dd yyyy" format (e.g. "Dec 02 2019") via toString(), while
toFileFormat() keeps the ISO form so it round-trips unambiguously
through Storage on reload.

Scope: only Deadline changes in this iteration. Event's /from and /to
are left as free-text for now - they're closer to a date *and* time
("Mon 2pm"), which would need a LocalDateTime-based design decision
rather than a direct copy of this change, so that's left for a
separate iteration if wanted.

Two user-facing message changes that follow from no longer accepting
arbitrary text:
- "/by date/time" -> "/by date" (it only ever stored a date already;
  this now reflects that it's no longer free text either)
- example in error messages changed from "/by Sunday" to the
  "/by 2019-12-02" format that's actually now required
- validateNoPipeCharacter(by) was dropped: by is no longer a stored
  raw string, so a '|' in it can't reach the save file - it's instead
  naturally rejected as an invalid date by LocalDate.parse

Storage.parseTaskFromFile parses the stored date back with
LocalDate.parse; any line with a date it can't parse (including an
old pre-Level-8 free-text date like "Sunday" left over from before
this change) is treated as a corrupted line and skipped with the
existing warning, same as any other malformed line - verified by
manually seeding a save file with such a line.

Verified via scripted sessions: valid date add + list + reload
(display format persists), several invalid-date and missing-date
inputs each produce the expected message, and the full prior
regression suite (todo/event/mark/unmark/delete) still passes
unchanged.

Not done in this iteration (left for later): the Level-8 stretch goal
(a command to list deadlines/events on a specific date), and applying
the same treatment to Event.
